rationale: C23 is a highly plausible drafting template. It uses the same proclamation form, statutory definition of “opiate,” sequence of findings, immediate-effect language, and operative declaration as the child. The child principally substitutes the newly codified 1954 statutory citation and a different named drug while preserving C23’s language and structure almost verbatim. C25 and C01 are also strong members of the same specific drafting lineage, but C23 is closest in date, administration, wording, and operative organization.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Whereas section 4731 (g) of the Internal Revenue Code of 1954 provides in part as follows: Opiate. The word "opiate"...shall mean any drug...found by the Secretary or his delegate, after due notice and opportunity for public hearing, to have an addiction-forming or addiction-sustaining liability similar to morphine or cocaine, and proclaimed by the President to have been so found
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Whereas section 3228 (f) of the Internal Revenue Code provides in part as follows: OPIATE.—The word "opiate"...shall mean any drug...found by the Secretary of the Treasury, after due notice and opportunity for public hearing, to have an addiction-forming or addiction-sustaining liability similar to morphine or cocaine, and proclaimed by the President to have been so found
shared_material.explanation: The child reproduces the distinctive statutory-definition recital, changing only the recodified provision and corresponding official terminology.

shared_material.child_excerpt: AND Whereas, the Secretary of the Treasury, after due notice and opportunity for public hearing, has found that the following named drug has an addiction-forming or addiction-sustaining liability similar to morphine, and that in the public interest this finding should be effective immediately
shared_material.parent_excerpt: AND Whereas the Secretary of the Treasury, after due notice and opportunity for public hearing, has found that each of the following-named drugs has addiction-forming and addiction-sustaining liability similar to morphine, and that in the public interest this finding should be effective immediately
shared_material.explanation: The factual finding clause is materially identical, with singular/plural adjustments for the number of drugs.

shared_material.child_excerpt: do hereby proclaim that the Secretary of the Treasury has found that the aforementioned drug has an addiction-forming or addiction-sustaining liability similar to morphine and that in the public interest this finding should be effective immediately
shared_material.parent_excerpt: do hereby proclaim that the Secretary of the Treasury has found that each of the aforementioned drugs...has an addiction-forming or addiction-sustaining liability similar to morphine, and that in the public interest this finding should be effective immediately
shared_material.explanation: The operative proclamation follows the same machinery and nearly verbatim formulation, adapted from multiple drugs to one drug.
